import ast, base64, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F

def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def norm(x):
    y=x%1
    return min(y,1-y)

path=Path('research/astra-multiple-contact-seed-control.json')
assert sha(path.read_bytes())=='adcfb74938b39dc6264ad78ee622860102d08e461487a114347224de910480c0'
r=json.loads(path.read_text()); s=r['frozen_source_before_execution']; e=r['execution']
for label in ['checker','plan']:
    assert sha(Path(s[label+'_path']).read_bytes())==s[label+'_sha256_before_execution']
blobs={}
for label in ['frozen_definition_prefix','reporting_driver','actual_child_program','parent_harness']:
    b=base64.b64decode(s[label+'_base64']);blobs[label]=b
    assert len(b)==s[label+'_bytes'] and sha(b)==s[label+'_sha256_before_execution']
assert blobs['actual_child_program']==blobs['frozen_definition_prefix']+b'\n'+blobs['reporting_driver']
assert Path(s['parent_harness_path']).read_bytes()==blobs['parent_harness']
tree=ast.parse(blobs['parent_harness'])
driver=next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='DRIVER' for t in n.targets))
assert driver.encode()==blobs['reporting_driver']
assert e['command']==s['outer_argv'][2]
assert sha(e['command'].encode())==s['outer_inline_command_sha256_before_execution']
assert e['child_exit_status']==0 and e['stderr']=='' and e['parse_error'] is None
for label in ['stdout','stderr']: assert sha(e[label].encode())==e[label+'_sha256']
data=r['results']; assert json.loads(e['stdout'])==data
v=tuple(data['tuple']); assert v==(1,5,7,8,10,11,13,17,18,19,23)
assert sha(json.dumps(v,separators=(',',':')).encode())==s['input_tuple_canonical_json_sha256']
delta,gamma=F(1,12),F(1,11)
assert data['N']==12 and data['Q_succeeds'] and data['all_deletion_seed_sets_nonempty']
assert len(data['per_label'])==11
for p,row in enumerate(data['per_label']):
    assert row['pivot_index']==p and row['pivot_speed']==v[p]
    assert row['seed_count']==len(row['seed_intervals'])>0
    t=F(row['attaining_time']);old=v[:p]+v[p+1:]
    assert all(norm(t*x)>=gamma for x in old)
    assert norm(t*v[p])+v[p]*min((norm(t*x)-delta)/x for x in old)==F(row['score_maximum'])
for a in (1,5,7,11):
    c=data['primitive_grid_contacts'][str(a)];phases=[(F(a,12)*x)%1 for x in v]
    assert list(map(F,c['phases']))==phases
    assert c['lower_delta_indices']==[i for i,x in enumerate(phases) if x==delta]
    assert c['upper_one_minus_delta_indices']==[i for i,x in enumerate(phases) if x==1-delta]
    assert c['lower_count']==c['upper_count']==2
full=[tuple(map(F,interval)) for interval in data['full_good_set']]
assert len(full)==10 and sum(L==R for L,R in full)==4 and sum(L<R for L,R in full)==6
for L,R in full:
    assert L<=R
    for x in v:
        k=(x*(L+R)/2).__floor__()
        assert k+delta<=x*L<=x*R<=k+1-delta
for q in range(2,12): assert data['divisibility_cover_q_2_through_11'][str(q)]==[x for x in v if x%q==0]
w=data['protected_witness'];t=F(w['time']);seed=F(w['seed_time']);p=w['pivot_index']
assert t==seed==F(45,88)
norms=[norm(t*x) for x in v]
assert norms==list(map(F,w['coordinate_norms'])) and min(norms)==gamma
rho=min((norm(seed*x)-delta)/x for j,x in enumerate(v) if j!=p)
assert rho==F(w['rho'])==F(1,1056) and abs(t-seed)<=rho
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','receipt_sha256':sha(path.read_bytes()),'labels':11,'full_components':10,'singletons':4,'positive_length_components':6,'full_gamma_witness':'45/88','all_real_enumeration_replayed':False,'verification':'Actual full frozen source and raw output bindings, retained attainers, interval containment and contact/witness records checked.'},sort_keys=True))
